title: C root DAO processing installs delegated sub-/128 targets as host routes, not prefix routes
description: With the generalized prefix gate (project-LICHEN-worker6-ekcc, l327) delegated sub-/128 Targets now install end-to-end: process_dao stores the canonical snapshot and rebuild_routes inserts the canonical prefix bytes as a host-style route (lichen_rpl_routing_table_add, is_prefix=false, path ends at the prefix value). Proper semantics per spec/05-routing.md 8.7.1 ('a Target prefix is reachability information, not a hop address; its zero-filled canonical value MUST NOT be inserted into a source route') require lichen_rpl_routing_table_add_prefix with egress=origin and managed-prefix reconciliation (Rust rebuilt_routes reconciles managed prefixes; C preserve_prefix_routes only preserves). Observable gap: exact-address lookup of the canonical prefix matches, but LPM for hosts inside the prefix does not. Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-ekcc. Needs snapshot prefix_len tracking or a parallel prefix-snapshot path.
